scope: Abstract NF telemetry and ordered operation simulation, not a live 5G core or implementation of a 3GPP procedure
episode_calibration: Quantile of per-NF maxima in disjoint 32-tick blocks from complete normal calibration runs; empirical target, not a formal bound
design_controls: Matched normal and attacked runs have identical initial randomness, context and legitimate lifecycle events
Joint shuffle preserves every raw univariate value in the affected interval
Token permutation and desynchronization preserve token histograms
Behavior labels exclude integrity-only and unobservable negative-control episodes
All rich models receive the same causal features; a simple structural comparator receives those features too
No positive performance result is required for a successful workflow
Calibration uses disjoint complete normal runs; no test-selected threshold or hyperparameter
Original experiment source files remain byte-identical
